figures.name: Jupiter

ability.name: Ius Divinum
ability.description: All light-alignment allies gain +2 to all stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: King of the Roman gods who enforces cosmic law and sanctions the power of emperors.

figures.name: Mars

ability.name: Legion's Wrath
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to all enemies; allies gain +2 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: Father of Romulus and divine patron of Rome's armies; both destroyer and protector.

figures.name: Juno

ability.name: Matron's Decree
ability.description: Remove all debuffs from all allies; inflict one debuff on the strongest enemy.

figures.description: Queen of the Roman gods, fierce protector of women and sworn enemy of Aeneas and his Trojan descendants.

figures.name: Neptune

ability.name: Trident Wave
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to one enemy and 2 damage to all adjacent enemies.

figures.description: Ruler of the seas whose trident can calm or shatter the ocean and shake the earth itself.

figures.name: Pluto

ability.name: Wealth of Shadows
ability.description: Steal 2 HP from all enemies and add it to your total HP pool.

figures.description: Lord of the Roman underworld and all underground riches, feared but rarely worshipped.

figures.name: Minerva

ability.name: Tactical Mastery
ability.description: View enemy strategy; your next three actions deal +2 bonus damage.

figures.description: Goddess of wisdom, craft and strategic warfare, said to have been born from Jupiter's head.

figures.name: Venus

ability.name: Irresistible Grace
ability.description: Charm one enemy: they fight for your side for 1 turn.

figures.description: Goddess of love and beauty who claimed Aeneas as her son and thus claimed Rome as her legacy.

figures.name: Mercury

ability.name: Caduceus Exchange
ability.description: Swap one of your card's stats with the same stat of an enemy card.

figures.description: Divine messenger and trickster who guides both living travelers and the souls of the dead.

figures.name: Aeneas

ability.name: Pietas
ability.description: When an ally falls, this card gains +2 to all stats for the rest of the battle.

figures.description: Trojan prince whose destined journey to Italy laid the mythological foundation for Rome's glory.

figures.name: Romulus

ability.name: City Wall Blessing
ability.description: Grant all allies a shield absorbing 3 damage; lasts until broken.

figures.description: Legendary founder and first king of Rome, sired by Mars himself, who slew his twin Remus.

figures.name: Bacchus

ability.name: Bacchanalia
ability.description: Inflict ecstasy on up to 3 enemies; they lose 2 wisdom and attack randomly.

figures.description: God of wine and liberation whose wild Bacchanalian rites swept through the Roman world.

figures.name: Janus

ability.name: Two-Faced Gate
ability.description: Look at one hidden enemy card; choose to delay its activation by 1 turn.

figures.description: Two-faced god of doorways and beginnings who sees simultaneously into the past and the future.

figures.name: Diana

ability.name: Lunar Hunt
ability.description: Target enemy cannot escape or use summon abilities; deal 4 damage.

figures.description: Huntress goddess of the moon who demands strict chastity from her followers and swift justice from her bow.

figures.name: Vulcan

ability.name: Masterwork Weapon
ability.description: Choose one ally; their next attack deals double damage and ignores defense.

figures.description: Divine blacksmith forged to the earth by Jupiter whose volcanoes are said to be his workshops.

figures.name: Fortuna

ability.name: Wheel of Fortune
ability.description: Randomize all stat bonuses currently active; 50% chance to double them or halve them.

figures.description: Blindfolded goddess of fortune who spins her wheel to raise and topple kings at random.

figures.name: Cacus

ability.name: Smoke Screen
ability.description: Reduce all enemies' accuracy; deal 3 fire damage to one target.

figures.description: Fire-breathing cave monster and cattle thief slain by Hercules; son of Vulcan.

figures.name: Laverna

ability.name: Thief's Veil
ability.description: Steal one random buff from an enemy and apply it to this card.

figures.description: Patron goddess of con artists, cheats and thieves, invoked at night in secret rituals.

figures.name: Faunus

ability.name: Wild Prophecy
ability.description: Reveal one enemy card's special ability before it activates.

figures.description: Rustic god of the wild countryside who sends prophetic dreams and protects flocks from wolves.

figures.name: Bellona

ability.name: Blood Rite
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to one enemy; gain +2 power for each ally currently below half HP.

figures.description: Ancient war goddess who preceded Mars in Roman worship and whose rites involved self-inflicted wounds.

figures.name: Terminus

ability.name: Sacred Boundary
ability.description: No enemy can use movement or position-swap abilities while this card is in play.

figures.description: Immovable god of boundary stones whose cult was so ancient even Jupiter could not displace him.
